message: the expected function type allows only `net.dial`, but performs `Conn.fx`

notes.message: `Conn.fx` is the effect argument left out of `Conn` here; an omitted effect argument stays an abstract effect variable of the function (core 6.2), as Rust and TypeScript generics would infer it, so a `uses` list cannot name it: write the effect argument, `Conn[..., net.dial]` naming the effects of the value passed in, or let the closure's effects be inferred
to pass the caller's effects through, name the effect parameter and list it: `fn f[fx: Effects](x: Conn[fx]) uses (..., fx)`, with `fx` in the closure's `uses` too (decision 0522)

fixes.title: write the effect argument: `Conn[()]`, a value that performs no effects (the effects of the value passed in when it performs some)
